name: @midnight-passport/connect
description: The Midnight Passport wire protocols and the client that speaks them: profile consent, transaction requests, and the signed redirect channel.
//dependencies: The three curve/hash/encoding libraries are reachable ONLY from the
`./redirect` entry point, which is why they are quarantined there and why
`.` and `./react` declare nothing. A dApp that never uses the signed
redirect channel never pays for a curve implementation: `sideEffects:
false` plus three separate entry points is what lets a bundler prove it.
They are pure JavaScript — no WebAssembly, no Midnight SDK — which is the
whole reason a Midnight identity can be verified inside an ordinary web
